description: This file defines an interface 'IAttributeToFactoryMapper' in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, responsible for mapping facet metadata to a cachable factory, with a method to get the factory based on parameter info and metadata.

classes.name: IAttributeToFactoryMapper
classes.description: An interface for mapping facet metadata to a cachable factory, with a method to retrieve the factory based on parameter info and metadata.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Returns a factory used to create facet instances for a grain, based on parameter info and facet metadata.
